title: Catch Bad AI Answers
body: Use a six-point check on a confident draft.
notes: AI can be wrong even when its prose is fluent.
aria: Catch Bad AI Answers. Use a six-point check on a confident draft.

title: Why check?
body: A fake skill can turn into an interview question.
notes: Start with a claim a student could explain.
aria: Why check?. A fake skill can turn into an interview question.

title: Six questions about a draft
body: Verify facts, added details, titles and numbers, filler, date and context, and spoken explanation.
notes: Use the same list throughout the class.
aria: Six questions about a draft. Verify facts, added details, titles and numbers, filler, date and context, and spoken explanation.

title: Invented facts
body: Look for a tool, GPA or award absent from the notes.
notes: Trace one noun back to a source.
aria: Invented facts. Look for a tool, GPA or award absent from the notes.

title: Inflated titles
body: Compare a crew member's duties with an unsupported operations-lead title.
notes: Restore the actual title.
aria: Inflated titles. Compare a crew member's duties with an unsupported operations-lead title.

title: Invented measurements
body: Ask where a claim of 40% sales growth came from.
notes: Remove the number if it was never measured.
aria: Invented measurements. Ask where a claim of 40% sales growth came from.

title: Confident filler
body: Look for sentences that contain no observable action.
notes: Replace one with a concrete verb.
aria: Confident filler. Look for sentences that contain no observable action.

title: Wrong time or context
body: Check current application instructions, age requirements and location.
notes: A true rule elsewhere may not fit here.
aria: Wrong time or context. Check current application instructions, age requirements and location.

title: Someone else's story
body: Separate what the team did from what the student did.
notes: Identify who owned the result.
aria: Someone else's story. Separate what the team did from what the student did.

title: Activity: mark six lines
body: Plant a fake tool, title and number in a fictional resume paragraph.
notes: Give source notes for comparison.
aria: Activity: mark six lines. Plant a fake tool, title and number in a fictional resume paragraph.

title: Mid-quiz: three snippets
body: Identify a failure in each snippet and explain the evidence.
notes: Mix missing facts with unsupported claims.
aria: Mid-quiz: three snippets. Identify a failure in each snippet and explain the evidence.

title: Find independent evidence
body: Use personal records for work and an assigned reliable source for school.
notes: Another AI answer does not verify a claim.
aria: Find independent evidence. Use personal records for work and an assigned reliable source for school.

title: When evidence is missing
body: Delete the claim or choose a narrower statement you can support.
notes: Keep the revision useful.
aria: When evidence is missing. Delete the claim or choose a narrower statement you can support.

title: Screen recording: repair a bad draft
body: Plan an 8–10 minute six-point check and correction of a made-up skill.
notes: Recording needed before paid release.
aria: Screen recording: repair a bad draft. Plan an 8–10 minute six-point check and correction of a made-up skill.

title: Activity: a homework paragraph
body: Find an invented date and a vague sentence using a supplied source excerpt.
notes: Do not ask for restricted student work.
aria: Activity: a homework paragraph. Find an invented date and a vague sentence using a supplied source excerpt.

title: Resume red flags
body: Check unfamiliar tools, formal titles, sports stats and language fluency.
notes: Ask what a student can actually demonstrate.
aria: Resume red flags. Check unfamiliar tools, formal titles, sports stats and language fluency.

title: Worksheet: 6-Point Check
body: Keep the checklist beside a draft and its corrected version.
notes: Include a place for the source of each correction.
aria: Worksheet: 6-Point Check. Keep the checklist beside a draft and its corrected version.

title: Before download
body: Review the exact resume text in the builder.
notes: The student decides which changes to keep.
aria: Before download. Review the exact resume text in the builder.

title: Common traps
body: Grammar can improve while a wrong number stays.
notes: Audit claims before polishing style.
aria: Common traps. Grammar can improve while a wrong number stays.

title: Recap
body: Name one way to verify each kind of error.
notes: Use the interview test last.
aria: Recap. Name one way to verify each kind of error.

title: Next: privacy
body: Practice checking a prompt before sharing it.
notes: Point to A4.
aria: Next: privacy. Practice checking a prompt before sharing it.

title: Optional completion line
body: Preview a record of finishing the class.
notes: A practice scenario is not job experience.
aria: Optional completion line. Preview a record of finishing the class.

title: End question: an invented detail
body: Find a claim missing from the note card.
notes: Ask which words need evidence.
aria: End question: an invented detail. Find a claim missing from the note card.

title: End question: an inflated title
body: Choose the title that matches the student's role.
notes: Explain how duties differ from titles.
aria: End question: an inflated title. Choose the title that matches the student's role.

title: End question: a fake metric
body: Use the check for dates, numbers and supporting records.
notes: Identify missing measurement.
aria: End question: a fake metric. Use the check for dates, numbers and supporting records.

title: End question: an unverified claim
body: Choose a smaller true claim or remove it.
notes: Reject a second unsupported guess.
aria: End question: an unverified claim. Choose a smaller true claim or remove it.

title: End question: generic text
body: Find the line that provides no identifiable action.
notes: Offer a concrete replacement.
aria: End question: generic text. Find the line that provides no identifiable action.

title: Answer review
body: Explain each answer and provide a retry.
notes: Four of five completes the class.
aria: Answer review. Explain each answer and provide a retry.

title: Practice draft one: source
body: Use an equipment check-in volunteer's raw notes.
notes: Identify duties and tools.
aria: Practice draft one: source. Use an equipment check-in volunteer's raw notes.

title: Practice draft one: audit
body: Check for a fake supervisor title and unsupported totals.
notes: Mark which check found each.
aria: Practice draft one: audit. Check for a fake supervisor title and unsupported totals.

title: Practice draft one: repair
body: Write one defensible line.
notes: Read it as an interviewer would.
aria: Practice draft one: repair. Write one defensible line.

title: Practice draft two: source
body: Provide a short fictional application notice with a date and location.
notes: Keep enough detail to check the answer.
aria: Practice draft two: source. Provide a short fictional application notice with a date and location.

title: Practice draft two: audit
body: Catch a superseded deadline and an assumption about age.
notes: Identify the source for each correction.
aria: Practice draft two: audit. Catch a superseded deadline and an assumption about age.

title: Practice draft two: repair
body: Draft a short accurate summary and flag what remains unknown.
notes: Compare it with the notice.
aria: Practice draft two: repair. Draft a short accurate summary and flag what remains unknown.

title: Close: use the checklist
body: Choose one sentence from a real draft to check.
notes: Work privately on paper or in a document.
aria: Close: use the checklist. Choose one sentence from a real draft to check.

title: What you can defend
body: Retain the final wording and the evidence for it.
notes: Leave uncertain claims out.
aria: What you can defend. Retain the final wording and the evidence for it.
